title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.4, 2026.1.5.1, 2025.3.6.2 code execution was possible in untrusted…
description: A code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3, 2026.2.4, 2026.1.5.1, and 2025.3.6.2. This flaw allows code execution in untrusted projects via script engine discovery. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.8.
